body: Please amend the current calibration-court draft before candidate freeze per the chief blocker note: provider/model selection must be completed development-only under a separate frozen protocol; calibration labels choose only externalFloor; untouched test chooses nothing. Promotion thresholds and required control margins must also be frozen before calibration outcomes, not merely before test unsealing. Make source-lineage-group terminology consistent in deletion stability. Add the two leakage mutations to the adversarial table. The rest of the current draft has no chief finding.
